data.name: Aatifah
data.gender_notes: Aatifah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'aatif', meaning 'to adorn'. The name Aatifah conveys the idea of a woman who is both refined and adorned, a fitting description for a beloved daughter in Islamic culture. The name Aatifah carries the meaning “Refined, adorned” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aatifah usually hope their child will grow to embody refined, adorned and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine beauty and grace.
data.etymology: Aatifah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Refined, adorned.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aatifah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
